name: AIGlobal order book (proxy_b7e1) pays out on a negative-amount order
summary: The AIGlobal order-book proxy's order entry (selector 0x9b3e9b92, unverified implementation) accepts a packed order word with a signed amount and matches it against order ids and fill amounts supplied by the caller. The attacker placed a crafted order, then a second order with a negative amount filling its own order for the proxy's whole USDT balance; the proxy paid 8,484.92 USDT to the attacker while both of its transferFrom calls collected 0 USDT, and also minted 33,940 AIGTC credits to it.
notes: The implementation 0x0df9d225 is unverified; the mechanism is read from the anchor's trace. Before the anchor the proxy's USDT outflows were round-number fills of ordinary AIG orders (largest 480 USDT); the proxy was upgraded 15 hours after the anchor (eip155:56:0x3647df07db03c00056d351263c7a544576608a629fa5b9efc22ff8d72ff0a539). The owner's change of slot 0x5 (fee recipient) did not affect the exploit. The minted AIGTC is unpriced and not counted.
